results.title: Better Future
results.overview: After four years as an immigrant in the United States, Julio, who works as part of the cleaning staff at a hospital, struggles to stay sober. Separated from his daughter and with his marriage in crisis, he searches for a fresh start amid the hardships of his daily life.

results.title: One Last Night
results.overview: On the eve of a life-changing separation, two best friends spend one last night together in Rio de Janeiro, determined to finish the song they have been writing before their paths take them in different directions.

results.title: Aldir Blanc - Response to Time
results.overview: Dorival Caymmi’s definition of Aldir Blanc is unequivocal: “Aldir Blanc is a jeweler of words.” Treating everyday language as gold, Aldir created a universe of his own, capturing like no one else the everyday life of Rio de Janeiro and Brazil through songs, poems, and chronicles.  More than a film about the artist’s life or body of work, this is an immersion into his universe—his inspirations, his personal geography, and his singular way of telling stories. An adventure through the musical and literary labyrinths of one of the most intriguing minds in contemporary Brazilian culture.

results.title: Wyppyd
results.overview: A serial sexual abuser given the moniker of "Whipping Tom," has been sentence to be exiled, but a vengeful nun inflicts a series of humiliating physical punishments onto the misogynistic scoundrel.

results.title: Still Warm
results.overview: At 2:17 AM in a quiet izakaya, two women find an awakening of desire, sparked by a humble tamagoyaki. Moist, rolling, layering—a culinary rhythm that mirrors their fleeting yet fierce night together. As dawn breaks, the tamagoyaki takes its final shape, and both women quietly emerge transformed.

results.title: Malick
results.overview: The life of Senegalese immigrant Malick changes abruptly when Toni—the man he believes to be the dangerous coyote who brought him to Brazil—crosses his path again. Inspired by the true story of Modou Awa Dieye.

results.title: LOUF
results.overview: In his debut feature documentary, Aziz Zoromba follows acclaimed chef Fadi Kattan and Canadian co-venturer Nicole Mankinen as they race to open a Palestinian restaurant in Toronto. While their dream takes shape, escalating attacks devastate Gaza and the West Bank. Part immersive food film and part urgent record, LOUF is a powerful meditation on diaspora, resistance, and the politics of preservation.

results.title: Phone Wallet Keys Door
results.overview: There’s fifteen minutes until Cal’s going to call the uber. Henrietta’s still doing her makeup, Bridget’s trying on everyone else’s clothes, and Josie only just got home from shift. Whose house party are we going to again?

results.title: Overt Listening
results.overview: Hong Kong–born artist Tiffany Sia confronts the Cold War legacy of China in this landscape film shot amidst the serene environs of Taiwan’s Kinmen archipelago. On this stretch of land only 1,800 meters from the coast of China, deserted beaches and abandoned military bunkers and training facilities harbor echoes of past conflict, such as the 1949 Battle of Guningtou, in which Taiwan defeated the Chinese Communist Party and maintained control of the land.

results.title: The Drug in Our Pocket
results.overview: Examines how smartphones, designed to connect us, have radically reshaped childhood, adolescence and mental health. Through intimate conversations with young people, parents, and leading experts, the film reveals a generation that is thoughtful, articulate, and increasingly aware of how digital environments shape their attention, emotions, and sense of self.

results.title: The Space She Left Behind
results.overview: When death takes a close friend away before he can say goodbye, a ten-year-old boy must learn to live with the empty space she left behind — through one dream where she returns to wave farewell.

results.title: Early Winter's Sorrow
results.overview: An elderly writer arrives at an abandoned village, where only derelict houses remain. He goes to the farm where he spent his childhood. After a new bridge was built, the village was plagued by robberies and threats, and his family moved to a small remote farming community. Their peaceful working environment was threatened by Russian soldiers monitoring the village by air and making harassing visits. The personal stories of the small community that we witness are adapted from the novels of Revaz Inanishvili.

results.title: Show me From Behind the Wall
results.original_title: Show me From Behind the Wall
results.overview: After several years of distance, Mary Jane agrees to reunite with a group of former friends for a trip meant to offer reconnection and rest. However, the reunion quickly becomes uncomfortable. Old wounds, unresolved conflicts, and buried secrets begin to surface, turning the experience into an increasingly tense and claustrophobic one. Isolated in a house far from the city, the women are forced to confront the past and face the emotional consequences of deep trauma. The film offers a disturbing portrait of the psychological deterioration of a woman pushed to her limits, where sanity dissolves and nothing is exactly as it seems.

results.title: A Knight to Remember
results.overview: A statue of an English knight arrives in Chicago for an art exhibit. While cleaning the statue, museum conservator Emily impulsively kisses the statue, bringing him to life.

results.title: Ultra Sound
results.overview: After a positive pregnancy test leads Wyn to discover she has no uterus, her life of sweeping romance is turned upside down, forcing her into a sudden and unexpected growth years later.

results.title: Claddagh
results.overview: Two sisters struggle to decide whether their deceased mother would like to be buried with her favorite Claddagh necklace, or leave it with them as an heirloom. The wrong decision could prove more devastating than either imagined.

results.title: Cony, intimate Portrait
results.overview: This documentary commemorates the centenary in 2026 of celebrated Brazilian writer and journalist Carlos Heitor Cony. Guided by his widow, Beatriz Lajta, after 40 years together, the film reveals the man behind the public figure. Featuring previously unseen home footage of their travels, friends, and shared passions—including piano, painting, and books—as well as readings narrated by Pedro Bial and interviews with Cony’s daughter and granddaughter, the documentary offers a mature, female perspective on a fascinating life, capturing his profound humanity and capacity for affection.

results.title: Blood in my Sink
results.overview: An old man unravels in a nightmarish reflection on aging, guilt, and the desperate wish to start over.

results.title: The "All-Nighter"
results.overview: Jace and Eli do their long awaited "All-Nighter", while Eli keeps a secret buried waiting to be cracked open
